# McMillan Running

> > The world's premier running coaching platform offering personalized training plans, certified coaching, and science-based strength programs powered by Greg McMillan's exercise physiology expertise.

McMillan Running provides comprehensive running training solutions from marathon pace calculators to personalized coaching, combining Greg McMillan's exercise science background with Lydiard training methodology. The platform serves runners of all levels through training plans, live coaching, video programs, and coach certification education.

## Key Topics

- Greg McMillan
- Marathon training
- Training plans
- Personal coaching
- Run Team coaching subscription
- Strength training
- Injury prevention
- Mobility exercises
- Pace calculator
- Coach certification
- Lydiard training methods
- Smartwatch integration
- Heart-rate training
- Running physiology

## Core Products & Services

- [McMillan Training Plans](https://www.mcmillanrunning.com/training-plans): Main product page for McMillan Training Plans covering marathons, 5K, 10K, and specialty races
- [McMillan Run Team Training](https://www.mcmillanrunning.com/product/mcmillan-training): Product page for McMillan Run Team coaching subscription with free trial and smartwatch integration
- [Personal Running Coach](https://www.mcmillanrunning.com/coaching): Personal online coaching service page featuring certified coaches including Greg McMillan
- [Custom Training Plans](https://www.mcmillanrunning.com/custom-training-plans): Custom personalized training plans from Coach Greg with strength training and injury prevention
- [Peak Performance Bundle](https://www.mcmillanrunning.com/product/peak-performance-bundle): Peak Performance Bundle combining Run Team coaching with strength, mobility, and marathon training

## Strength & Mobility Programs

- [McMillan Strength & Prehab](https://www.mcmillanrunning.com/strength-prehab-2): Strength and prehab product featuring 3HAB routines, core work, and injury prevention programs
- [Magic Mobility](https://www.mcmillanrunning.com/magic-mobility): Magic Mobility on-demand video program by Angela Tieri for flexibility and stride improvement
- [Marathon Legs - Stage 1](https://www.mcmillanrunning.com/marathon-legs): Marathon Legs 12-week strength program by Angela Tieri addressing late-race fatigue and eccentric strength

## Education & Resources

- [Running University](https://www.mcmillanrunning.com/learn): Educational library with articles on marathon training, nutrition, recovery, and running tips
- [Greg McMillan's Books](https://www.mcmillanrunning.com/books): Greg McMillan's published books on running training, including 'YOU (Only Faster)' and running lessons
- [My Coaching Content](https://www.mcmillanrunning.com/my-coaching-content): Member access to purchased McMillan Running coaching webinars and educational courses
- [My Videos](https://www.mcmillanrunning.com/my-videos): Video library with purchased McMillan Running content including mobility and recovery routines

## Coach Training & Certification

- [For Coaches](https://www.mcmillanrunning.com/for-coaches): Coach education and certification program based on Lydiard training methods and physiology
- [Coach Certification Program](https://www.mcmillanrunning.com/mcmillan-coaching-certification-interest): Coaching certification program registration based on Lydiard training and running physiology

- [Greg McMillan](https://www.mcmillanrunning.com/greg-mcmillan): Coach Greg McMillan's biography highlighting his exercise science background and coaching accomplishments
